title: Buttons and Dials
description: this mod includes 8 different coins, from copper to diamond, each with a different price
body:
this mod includes 8 different coins, called buttons and dials, from copper to diamond, each with a different price

buttons:

copper - 1p
iron - 5p
gold - 10p
diamond - 50p

dials:

copper - £1
iron - £5
gold - £10
diamond - £50
